correctness.rationale: From explicit six edge families reconstruct the distance profile (1,5,5,1). All independent edges split as 30 distance-two pairs (each in two triangles) and 6 antipodal pairs (in no triangle); no independent quadruple. The distance-two graph is icosahedral, with 20 triangles and 12 five-cycle vertex links, hence S2. Attaching the six antipodal diameters gives S2 wedge6 S1. Relative LES of (K,S2) gives an equivariant integral H1 isomorphism to oriented antipodal edges mapped [x,alpha x] to e_x-e_alpha x; H2 sphere orientation class. Rotations preserve sphere orientation, central antipode reverses it by Lefschetz fixed-simplex count. Character from signed fixed antipodal edges is rotational (6,-2,0,1,1), the rational six-dimensional irreducible W6. Independent construction verified (f0,f1,f2)=(12,36,20), sphere (12,30,20), six antipodal pairs, exactly 120 graph automorphisms and H1 trace multiplicities {6:1,-6:1,2:15,-2:15,0:40,1:24,-1:24}. All ranks integral from geometric decomposition, not inferred from mod two.
residual_risks: The natural H1 is an anti-invariant integral lattice, not an integral sum of the two conjugate three-dimensional complex irreducibles; rational-only latter decomposition is intentional.
Finite exact graph theorem; no generalization to other platonic solids.
